productRequirement: Temporary→secondary→primary and open/shelved secondary environments must retain the SAME environment/Profile/login and children; global URL favorites are separate. No silent private-mode flip, new-Profile swap, JS-cookie-only migration or metadata-only restoration claim.
currentNativeFactory: Temporary/private-cookie only,8live sessions. PartitionCatalog contexts are process-local and cannot be reconstituted merely from IPC/catalog labels.

pinnedGecko.sessionPrivateAndContextSettings: Actual SDK: Builder.usePrivateMode/contextId set private GeckoSessionSettings setters; no public live-session conversion API. Reopening a new normal session does NOT prove existing private login/storage transferred.
pinnedGecko.contextClear: StorageController.clearDataForSessionContext returns void and dispatches GeckoView:ClearSessionContextData. Pinned GeckoViewStorageController clearSessionContextData calls clearData/QMS without returning a completion receipt. SDK requires closing all affected sessions before clearing to avoid reaccumulation. Return/timeout/barrier guessing cannot certify erasure.
pinnedGecko.checkpoint: SessionState.toString invokes mState.toJSONObject().toString; writeToParcel first invokes toString. Post-string truncation/dataSize is too late to bound the first full materialization. Public history list is not full hidden form/storage/checkpoint state.
pinnedGecko.runtimeLifetime: One main GeckoThread/runtime initialization; same-process second-runtime/alternate-profile fallback is not a valid migration strategy.
pinnedGecko.startupConfig: Default null configFilePath can read external /data/local/tmp package YAML for debuggable apps and merge args/preferences/extras; corrected separately in actual R63 runtime startup. Empty disables this pinned path; no hostile file was created for tests.

requiredBeforePersistentEnablement: Source/epoch-bound native Gecko profile namespace and birth before runtime creation; no external/Intent path, unrecognized-directory adoption or default-key repair
Canonical durable native workspace→context binding and actual owner-issued restoration admission; authenticated metadata remains separate from latest/current document/permission authority
Preserve existing live private environment or explicitly keep it unpromotable pending supported lossless conversion; never silently drop HttpOnly cookies/IDB/localStorage/service workers

If investigating future promotable contexts backed persistently from their birth, keep old private contexts untouched and assess temporary privacy/lifetime/clear semantics first; this is an option, not an approved completed design
Bounded native checkpoint capture/restore with honest partial-vs-full semantics, original child/context association, failure/unknown states and actual IO close/readback
Integrated actual UI/store/runtime open→shelf→cold→restore journey with same cookie/storage identity; no detached registry/method-count completion
Epoch cutover/erasure must track native runtime, sessions, queued IO and all storage owners; close/Java return/timeout do not establish whole cleanup
implementedFromThisReview: Only R63 fixed runtime startup configuration/readback, tested on actual Android. Persistent environment/profile birth, conversion and restoration remain pending.
